shared_elements: long horizontal line dividing the field
repeated row of small identical marks (dots/strokes/heads)
reduced silhouette-style figures on a plain ground
justification: Both surfaces reduce living forms to flat, outline-legible silhouettes and both include a long horizontal line crossed by repeated small marks, plus discs, crescent-shaped objects and profile creatures, which gives a loose generic kinship. But A is a three-dimensional low-relief carving on an upright block organised into stacked horizontal registers dominated by animals, while B is a flat pigment-filled pecked surface with figures and boats scattered across an open horizontal field, so composition and technique diverge sharply.
